work.description: Fragment witness; the source omits part of the act. The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent CCCLXVI synopsis, actual outer Glemens episcopus protocol25330–25332, §§1–12, Datum26022–26026 and papal/cardinal subscriptions26028–26179 before CCCLXVII26187. Catalog Gregorius25405 is narrated predecessor, not issuer. Fragment: current §1 is expressly replaced at25408–25410 by etc. and Omittitur narrativa huius bullae with a cross-reference; note25447–25449 repeats the omission and points to earlier CCCLXIV. This omits substantive outer-act narrative, beyond a conventional sanction formula. Do not supply words from the separate earlier brief. Exclude preceding act's displaced note25335–25337 from the refined fragment range; other historical notes25339–25342/25394–25396,25496–25501,25603–25610,25667,25716,25763–25765,25924–25929 and26036 belong this act.
